channel.title: Aviation, shipping & logistics · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Aviation, shipping & logistics in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.3).

item.title: [+2] Brent plunges 7.63% to $104.77, its biggest drop in months, as Iran opens the door to talks
item.description:
WTI fell 7.36% to $96.46. Down from a six-month high of $117.64 on Friday. Reversing October's surge; strike risk after the 3 November US vote remains.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: tailwind (+2) — Fuel costs fall

Why it matters: A $13 drop in three sessions sharply cuts India's import bill, fuel-subsidy risk and inflation pressure, easing the rupee and bond yields.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +2, Inflation outlook +2

Confidence: high · horizon: days

item.title: [−2] US conducts 'defensive strikes' on Iranian targets in Hormuz; Indian sailor killed off Oman
item.description:
Thirteen crew were rescued. A new wave of attacks hit tankers and an LNG carrier. Escalation on the water even as talks advance.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: headwind (−2) — Crew death, insurance

Why it matters: Continued attacks keep freight, insurance and crew risks high for Indian shipping and threaten the oil relief from diplomacy.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] Iran's supreme leader authorises the government to pursue peace talks with the US
item.description:
The US president says a deal 'could happen' and oil is 'dropping like a rock'. Iran still demands seven conditions and says Hormuz stays shut until the blockade ends. Biggest diplomatic step in weeks.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild tailwind (+1) — Route reopening hopes

Why it matters: A path to reopening Hormuz would be the largest relief for India's oil, LNG and freight costs; conditions keep the outcome uncertain.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
